Output written and every cited line re-checked against the pinned tree.

- `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener-ds-rescreen/30250.json`
- Trust decision: an IO-backed FBuffer's capacity is trusted in `fbuffer_do_inc_capa` — the stack→`FBUFFER_IO_BUFFER_SIZE` promotion returns on `requested < fb->capa` without counting the already-buffered `len`, so the promoting append writes up to 511 bytes past the new heap block (`ext/json/ext/fbuffer/fbuffer.h:97-121`, reached from `generator.c:1306-1314` and `:1866-1876`).
- `pattern_fit`: A (two entry-point functions plus a lower-level buffer helper one module away, input-shape window, and an observable IO-identity/flush contract).
- Strongest lever: the input-shape window — only a document whose prefix fills part of the 512-byte stack buffer followed by a single 15872–16382-byte append overflows, and the root site is the shared `fbuffer.h` growth maths, not the generator the report names.
- Biggest red flag: `tiny_repo` — 125 files, one C sink, and a generator.c-only or one-line guard change is behaviourally sufficient, so `overtesting` scope may not hold models back; additionally detection likely needs ASAN.
